title: What's NodeAgent · node-agent
hero.title: What's NodeAgent
hero.tagline: An agent you run yourself: it remembers you, it gets things done, and it wakes up on your schedule.
what.title: What you can do with it
what.chat.text: Say it in the chat on the left. The whole history is kept, so a restart picks up where you left off.
what.remember.text: Preferences, project background and what happened go into notes, so you never explain them twice.
what.schedule.text: Today's work goes into todo, reminders into timer — or let it run a task on a schedule.
what.act.text: Have it run commands, read and write files, search the web; what it may do, and how far, is yours to set on the system page.

connect.intro3: This is the join token of the current user: hand it only to a computer you trust. A node that joins with the bus's raw token does not appear in this user's UI.
connect.loopback.local: This bus is listening on loopback. A node on another computer cannot reach that address; start the stack with a reachable bind address before using it remotely.
connect.loopback.remote: This bus address is not loopback. Make sure the port is reachable from the computer that will run the node, and keep the token private.
